tidbit: Did you know… about 14,000 new articles reached our newsroom in the last 24 hours.
transcript:
Hourly brief, Founders' Preview. Here is what is moving in superintelligence (SI), the next generation of artificial intelligence (AI).
OpenAI used artificial intelligence to investigate a hidden device, leading to an employee's firing and FBI arrest, Confirmed by EconoTimes.
Reported by Bloomberg: Anthropic asked an appeals court to rehear a fight over security risk.
Anthropic rolled out defenses to block artificial intelligence model distillation, cutting extracted tokens by 10 to 100 times, Reported by BankInfoSecurity.
Confirmed by TechCrunch: A CEO predicts home artificial intelligence assistants will know users and handle purchases by 2026.
Anthropic warns small artificial intelligence models could replicate on Internet of Things devices by 2026, with one model successfully spreading across eight devices, Confirmed by Scripps News.
Free every hour.
